title: Vigenere cipher
prompt: Read from standard input: a first line with the key (one or more lowercase letters), then lines of the form `E text` or `D text`: a command letter, one space, and the text. For `E` print the text encrypted with the Vigenere cipher, for `D` print it decrypted. Only the letters `a-z` and `A-Z` of the text are changed: the i-th letter of the text (counting only letters, from 0, restarting at 0 on every line) is moved forward (E) or backward (D) in the alphabet by the value of the key letter at position i modulo the key length (`a` is 0, `b` is 1, ...), wrapping around, and keeps its case. All other characters (spaces, digits, punctuation) stay where they are and do not use up a key letter. A line that does not start with `E ` or `D ` prints `error`. The text may be empty after the command (`E ` prints an empty line).

cases.name: example
cases.stdin:
lemon
E Attack at dawn!
D Lxfopv ef rnhr!
E 
X nope
E Zz
cases.expected_output:
Lxfopv ef rnhr!
Attack at dawn!

error
Kd
